hypotheses.J0_full_bidegree_recomposition_is_exact: The full bidegree grid recomposes direct gradients with cosine at least 0.999 and relative error at most 0.02 at every site.
hypotheses.J1_rectangle8_replication: The 8-by-8 rectangle reaches median gradient cosine at least 0.90 and 10th percentile at least 0.75.
hypotheses.J2_rectangle8_finite_direction: Its top-64 positive supports increase semantic score on at least 95% of finite patches.
hypotheses.J3_rectangle8_causal_strength: Its mean finite shift is at least 80% of the exact-gradient support's mean shift.
hypotheses.J4_cross_paths_beat_axes: Rectangle 8 exceeds the pure-axis union by at least 0.15 median gradient cosine and 0.10 mean-shift ratio.
hypotheses.J5_rectangle8_transfers_across_features: Every feature has median rectangle-8 gradient cosine at least 0.75 and finite directional fraction at least 0.75.
hypotheses.J6_rectangle4_is_insufficient_control: Rectangle 4 has median gradient cosine below 0.80 or mean-shift ratio below 0.70.
